MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 9 = 20. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 12
   C. 9
   D. 20

2. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 12
   C. 13
   D. 1

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 12

4. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 1
   C. 9
   D. 20

5. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 11
   C. 29
   D. 3

6. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

7. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 14

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 81

9. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 24

10. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 33
   D. 4

11. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 31
   C. 43
   D. 41

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 5

13. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 50

14. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 3, 6, 9
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 2, 4, 6

15. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 81

16. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 22

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
